otp.description: 4-digit session OTP. Included only when the viewer is the client and status is ACCEPTED or ACTIVE.

get.summary: Get all companions with filtering options
get.description: Returns a ranked, paginated companion feed. Query parameter names are camelCase and case-sensitive. Use activityTypes (not search) to filter by activity labels stored on the user profile.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by companion username substring (case-insensitive). Does not search activities or bio.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Filter by user gender (case-insensitive), e.g. male, female.

parameters.name: activityTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated activity strings; must match values in user.activityType exactly (hasSome). Example: Coffee,Dinner or Fine Dining.

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: Comma-separated languages; must match user.languages exactly (hasSome).

parameters.name: trustRank
parameters.description: Comma-separated trust ranks on companion profile, e.g. Premium,New.

get.description: Returns a single companion profile by the companion's **User.id** (not CompanionProfile.id). Includes active **moments** for the story viewer when the client taps the profile photo, **allMomentsSeen** for the avatar ring, **momentsAnalytics** (lifetime like/ring/diamond totals), reviews, and performance stats.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Companion user id (User.id linked to CompanionProfile)

isSaved.description: Whether the authenticated user saved this companion

allMomentsSeen.description: True if the viewer has seen all active moments (profile ring state).

moments.description: Active (non-expired) moments for story viewer when tapping profile photo.

momentsAnalytics.description: Lifetime totals summed across all moments (including expired). Shown on profile MOMENTS ANALYTICS cards.

totalLikes.description: Sum of likes (heart) on all moments

totalRings.description: Sum of rings on all moments

totalDiamonds.description: Sum of diamonds on all moments

performance.description: Derived performance block for profile UI

post.description: Update the Firebase Cloud Messaging token for the authenticated companion for push notifications.
Update the Firebase Cloud Messaging token for the authenticated user for push notifications.
Testing only — no authentication. Sends FCM to the given device token. If userId is provided, saves the token on that user and creates an in-app notification record.

userId.description: Optional. If set, updates this user's fcmToken and saves an in-app notification.

title.description: Optional notification title. Default: Jikanzo test

body.description: Optional notification body. Default: Push notifications are working.

400.description: Missing fcm or FCM not sent
